items.name: Austrian Open 2019
items.information: Autrian Open 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other related puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. This competition is NOT a national championship for Austria.

items.name: Eagle of the East Azerbaijan 2019
items.information: Qafqazın ən böyük şəhəri olan, qartal şəklində Azərbaycanın şərqində və Xəzərin sahilində yerləşən gözəl Bakımıza xoş gəlmisiniz! Şərq Qartalı 2019 (Eagle of the East 2019) bütün iştirakçılara açıq olan, dost mühitində keçiriləcək əyləncəli bir Rubik kubu yarışıdır. Halhazırda Cənubi Qafqazın ən böyük yarışlarından biri olan bu ənənəvi yarışda bu il də çoxlu iştirakçı görməyi ümid edirik. _____ Welcome once again to Baku – largest city in Caucasus, beautifully situated by the eagle-like east part of Azerbaijan! Eagle of the East 2019 is a friendly and relaxed cube competition open to all who wish to participate. It is currently one of the largest competitions in South Caucasus and we are hoping for many participants also this year. ________ ![Image description](https://scontent.fbud2-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/11428087_504865869672856_3234049640222750342_n.jpg?_nc_cat=100&oh=68a71e969ab9b028b1d44ac0caf4b750&oe=5C89D162)
